title: Kimberly-Clark completes $48.7 billion acquisition of Kenvue
summary: The acquisition marks Kimberly-Clark’s expansion into the beauty category, and will see Kenvue’s health and beauty brands Neutrogena, Aveeno, OGX and Listerine sit under the same umbrella as Kenvue’s personal care brands

title: Exclusive: Estée Lauder Companies’ Senior VP & General Manager, UK & Ireland, steps down
summary: Pernilla Nyberg has resigned as Estée Lauder Companies’ Senior VP & General Manager, UK & Ireland, and will be succeeded by Umair Ansari, who is currently serving as the company’s Senior VP & General Manager, Travel Retail EMEA & Americas

title: Why beauty brands are checking into hotels
summary: Floral Street, Skin Rocks and Merit Beauty are among the beauty brands checking into the hospitality space, with hotel partnerships offering opportunities to find new audiences, provide personalised experiences, and develop authentic collaborations

title: How luxury beauty is taking off in travel retail
summary: Beauty’s premium players such as L’Oréal and Estée Lauder Companies have been increasingly benefiting from travel retail, as the humble airport creates a shift in consumer shopping habits that is allowing luxury beauty to thrive

title: Puig CEO wants the company to become a ‘global dermocosmetics champion’
summary: Puig CEO Jose Manuel Albesa spoke on the importance of the beauty company carving its place in the dermocosmetics category, bolstering its offering by taking full ownership of Isdin next year and planning to double the sales of Uriage by 2032

title: Ulta Beauty unveils star-studded holiday campaign with Selena Gomez and Tate McRae
summary: Ulta Beauty’s 2026 festive campaign has arrived, featuring a star studded cast including beauty brand founders Selena Gomez, Tracee Ellis Ross, Jennifer Aniston and Ice Spice

title: Ouai enters fragrance wearables through Heaven Mayhem jewellery collaboration
summary: Jen Atkin’s hair and body care brand, Ouai, has partnered with accessories and lifestyle brand Heaven Mayhem to launch a collection of amulets which reimagine how fragrance is worn

title: Nails.Inc founder Thea Green exits the business after 27 years
summary: The departure of Nails.Inc founder and Chairwoman Thea Green comes two years after the British nail care brand was sold to Pacific World Corporation

title: The Ingredients Store and Vantage Personal Care partner to expand digital access to ingredients
summary: The partnership brings Vantage’s speciality ingredients and natural oils to The Ingredients Store’s fast-growing digital platform, supporting indie brands, formulators and manufacturers seeking easier access to high-quality materials

title: Kleonne expands men’s grooming platform with routine building and concern-led shopping
summary: The platform brings curated brands, practical guidance and a single checkout together, with brand bundles and customer accounts next in development

title: Uniproma advances sunscreen formulation with lipid microsphere encapsulation
summary: Sunsafe Fusion C4 and C5 combine multiple organic UV filters within a pre-dispersed lipid microsphere system, supporting enhanced UVA and UVB protection, stable dispersion and convenient incorporation. Uniproma will showcase the technology and sunscreen prototypes at in-cosmetics Asia 2026

title: Givaudan Active Beauty unveils SensoTrue DM5, a bioptimised alternative to DM5 silicone for professional hair care
summary: Leveraging biotechnology to redefine silicone substitutes through professional performance, naturality and formulation versatility

title: GEKA’s lumiLOOP turns lash care into a complete ritual
summary: Lash care no longer begins and ends with mascara. As beauty routines become increasingly holistic, make-up performance, removal and targeted care are moving closer together. GEKA’s Lash Care Essentials translate this idea into one complete routine

title: Spa formulations for rebooting rituals
summary: Formulations for spa products, from masks and scrubs to products to aid relaxation
